basic_info.description: Gorgeous and move-in ready, this updated tunnel entrance home blends classic charm with modern upgrades. The spacious west-facing living room features an original fireplace and flows seamlessly into a formal dining room, while the remodeled kitchen (2013) offers both style and function. The top level includes three separate bedrooms at the rear of the home, two remodeled bathrooms, and direct access to the backyard from one of the bedrooms. Two interior stairways connect the main floor to the expansive ground level, which offers two-car tandem parking, abundant storage, a huge family room with wet bar, office, and an additional bath. The large, flat backyard is perfect for barbecues, gatherings, or simply relaxing outdoors. This home is loaded with upgrades and bonuses, including a fully owned solar power system, double-pane windows, added insulation, and new flooring throughout the ground floor level. Conveniently located near Quintara Street & 19th Avenue public transit, Taraval and Noriega Street shops and restaurants, and the Taraval Street MUNI lines, you'll also enjoy easy access to local parks and playgrounds such as Sunset Reservoir, McCoppin Square, Stern Grove, and Parkside Square. With space, style, and thoughtful improvements, this home is truly a rare find!
